subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should authenticated hook-agent callers be allowed to opt into reusing an existing fresh session selected by a policy-approved session key?
rationale: This adds a deliberate transcript-reentry capability at an external ingress boundary; code inspection can validate mechanics, but only maintainers can approve the permanent security and product contract.

options.title: Approve explicit persistence
options.body: Allow `sessionMode: "persistent"` only as an explicit opt-in while preserving isolated default behavior and existing auth, prefix, and agent-scoping checks.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated
options.body: Reject persistent re-entry, keep every hook turn detached, and document that stable session keys provide routing metadata rather than transcript continuity.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit persistence
recommendation.body: Allow `sessionMode: "persistent"` only as an explicit opt-in while preserving isolated default behavior and existing auth, prefix, and agent-scoping checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The hook dispatch and security history plus the prior issue review make steipete the strongest available owner for this boundary decision.
